title: Product promo video (starts the render in the background)
description: Starts a promo render from a video spec as a background job (shell_job sees it, stops it and lists it): title card, turntable, the parts coming together in list order with their names, end card, cut to the exact duration. Returns at once with the job id; the job keeps going after the turn ends and writes <video>.done.json when it finishes. skills/product-video says what goes in the spec and how to wait.

params.name: spec
params.description: The video spec, a JSON file (parts, title, subtitle, end line, duration, resolution, style).

steps.note: Then: node <same script> wait <spec> (exit 0 done, 1 failed, 2 still running), or status; shell_job status, output or stop with the job id.
